items.title: Implement experience-hint-loader: load, rank, filter, format top-N hints
items.context: core/experience-hint-loader.ts: read finding-signals.json via learning-store; rank by priority = signalScore*log(1+support)*recencyBoost; recurring-issue hints require signalScore>=0.65; low-score+high-false-positive => common_false_positive hints; top-N (<=3 recurring + 2 false-positive) with progressive disclosure (summary first). Zero outward imports except learning-store (read-only) + types.
items.userSees: The smoke asserts the loader returns ranked top-N hints with correct priority ordering, the score-threshold filter, the common-false-positive bucket, and support shown alongside score.

items.title: Surface hints as an advisory section in story-review (mirror grillSection)
items.context: handlers/story-review.ts: add an experienceHintsSection (advisory only) into the _reviewPrompt advisory output, mirroring grillSection placement, sourced from experience-hint-loader. Clearly labelled 'Project experience hints (advisory only)'. Advisory-only; does not change any gate.
items.userSees: story_review output _reviewPrompt includes a 'Project experience hints (advisory only)' section when signals exist; absent/empty when there are none.

items.title: Usage tracking + promptHash determinism guardrail
items.context: Surfacing writes an experience_hint_surfaced event (storyId, hintIds) to the activity log via appendActivityLog. GUARDRAIL: resolveReviewPromptHash (core/review-run.ts) must remain independent of experience hints — hint content must never feed the reviewRunId promptHash domain.
items.userSees: The smoke asserts an experience_hint_surfaced event is appended when hints surface, and that resolveReviewPromptHash output is identical regardless of experience-hint content (deterministic reviewRunId binding unaffected).
